entryDocs.name: e-Arrival Card
entryDocs.description: Submit within 3 days before arrival. K-ETA holders and registered foreigners are exempt. Valid for 72 hours after submission.

entryDocs.name: Q-Code
entryDocs.description: Not mandatory, but allows faster immigration and skips the health questionnaire at the airport.

physical.tip: Buy at airport convenience stores or telecom booths
